_: Model classification (Clef on Workers AI). The model picks from these lists and returns calibrated probabilities. Edit the lists freely: a changed list changes the input hash, so cached answers are asked again.
_decisive: An answer is applied when its option has at least minProbability and leads the runner-up by minMargin. Clef's own confidence is not used: it is entropy over every option, so a clear pick among 26 industries (0.6 against 0.05) still scores 0.3 to 0.5.
_kindIndustry: Segments whose industry follows from the segment itself, set without a model call.
_industries: Industry keys as stored on companies.industry, with the description the model reads. Places niches use the same keys. 'other' is a real answer: stored so the company is not asked again.

industries.clinic: private medical clinic, diagnostics, medical center (not dental)
industries.repair: renovation, repair, construction services for homes
industries.retail: physical or online shop selling goods
industries.education: school, courses, language school, education provider
industries.fitness: gym, fitness club, yoga or sport studio
industries.agency: digital, marketing, design or software services agency
industries.saas: software product sold as a service
industries.games: video, mobile or PC game developer or publisher (not gambling)
industries.gambling: gambling, casino, betting, iGaming, casino game providers
industries.investor: venture fund, accelerator, angel network, investor
industries.public: government body, municipality, state enterprise, public utility

_kinds: Segment for a company still 'unknown' after tags and sources. smb, ecommerce and public are left out on purpose: only a source or the owner sets them (CLAUDE.md section 3).

kinds.studio: web or software development agency or studio doing projects for clients
kinds.design: design agency or studio (branding, UI/UX) doing projects for clients
kinds.startup: young product company, small team, building its own product
kinds.product: established product company with its own engineering team
kinds.outstaff: outstaffing or staff augmentation company renting out developers
kinds.other: none of the above or not enough information

_leadFit: Tender fit for a solo full-stack developer, lowest first. Stored on leads.fit as 0 to 100; the score ignores tenders under companies.minLeadFit in scoring.json.
leadFit: not software at all: equipment, licences, hardware, printing, services
software, but not a build: support or hosting contract, licence renewal, large ERP or state registry
unclear from the text, or a build too large for one developer
a website, portal, web app or integration a solo developer can build
